extraction_notes: Only SI experimental catalyst-performance data were extracted. SI Table S1 (kinetic parameters), SI Table S2 (activation energies), characterization figures, DFT results, and SI Table S4 literature-comparison table were not extracted. SI Figure S5 was not extracted as distinct condition entries because the SI caption does not state the reaction temperature/pressure/feed for those points. SI Figure S6 time-on-stream plot was not digitized because the many closely spaced markers and small plot make individual time/conversion values unreliable; it shows approximately stable CO2 conversion near 15% for 0.92In-4.6Cu/CeO2 at 290 °C, 30 bar, WHSV 7200 ml gCat-1 h-1, CO2:H2:N2 = 1:3:1. SI Figure S4 values are approximate visual readings from bar charts.
